headline: Salasar Techno Engineering submits AGM voting report
hook: Salasar Techno AGM voting results filed
summary: Salasar Techno Engineering has filed its scrutinizer's report following the Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company also submitted the official voting results to the exchange. This filing confirms the completion of the procedural requirements for the meeting.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural update with no immediate impact on share price.

headline: Salasar Techno Engineering discloses proceedings from its 25th Annual General Meeting
summary: Salasar Techno Engineering Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges about the proceedings of its 25th Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Such disclosures are routine corporate compliance required for listed entities under SEBI regulations. For retail investors, these filings provide formal records of shareholder approvals and discussions but carry no immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on share price.
